description.text: Training goal：Based in China and facing the world, to cultivate middle and senior information talents with good humanities and social science literacy, international vision and teamwork spirit, with systematic, solid and broad theoretical foundation of computer science, and with strong engineering implementation ability and innovation ability. Graduates have the ability to engage in applied research, design, development and management of computer science and technology in the information technology industry, scientific research departments and related fieldscore courses：Professional introduction, Database Principle and application, Software engineering Foundation, algorithm design and analysis, software quality assurance and testing, software architecture, software project management

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Zhejiang Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate photo (recent 2-inch bareheaded photo);2. Scanned copy of the first page of the passport (ordinary passport, valid after October 31, 2025);3. Passport visa page (required for students already in China);4. Notarized high school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate must be stamped with the official seal of the school:(1) Fresh high school graduates submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school,(2) senior high school students who have graduated submit their high school diploma;5. Scanned copy of notarized transcript:(1) Fresh high school graduates submit transcripts during the school years,(2) Students who have graduated from high school submit complete transcripts of high school;(3) High school test scores or internationally accepted standardized test scores, such as UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT, etc.;6. Proof of language proficiency within the validity period:Applicants for English-taught programs are required to submit TOEFL IBT or IELTS transcripts with a TOEFL IBT score of 80 or above and IELTS score of 5.5 or above. Applicants who have taken English as the language of instruction in senior high school may present a language of instruction certificate issued by the senior high school as a substitute;7.Medical examination form for foreigners8.Proof of no criminal record (within 6 months)9.Declaration of no history of drug use 10.Proof of financial ability: Deposit proof sufficient to cover reasonable expenses of study, living and international travel during the period of study in China (at least one semester's tuition fee should be held);11. Study plan: no less than 1000 words. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs should write in Chinese; applicants for English-taught programs should write in English;12. Students who have studied in China must provide proof of their studies in their original school;

requirements.text: 1.Be at least 18 years old and generally not more than 30 years old (born before September 1, 1995）2. Non-chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports,3. Fresh high school graduates or have a high school diploma, high school performance is good;4. Language proficiency: HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught majors, TOEFL 80 or IELTS 5.5 for English-taught majors;5. No criminal record, no history of drug abuse;6. In good health, no major infectious diseases.
